tool_plan.objective: Generate and preserve representative Chromium HTTP cache content that ChromeCacheView can list, inspect, export, and copy.

required_actions.name: browser.launch
required_actions.why: Launch Chrome with a known Chromium profile so HTTP cache data is written to a collectable profile location.

required_actions.name: browser.goto
required_actions.why: Load runtime-provided pages that return documents and embedded resources suitable for Chromium HTTP caching.

required_actions.name: browser.get_clickables
required_actions.why: Observe currently visible controls before performing content-changing interactions that can request additional cacheable resources.

required_actions.name: browser.smart_type
required_actions.why: Submit realistic visible search or form input to request parameter-dependent content and corresponding cache responses.

required_actions.name: browser.click
required_actions.why: Activate an observed visible control when it produces a document transition or requests additional page resources.

required_actions.name: browser.smart_click
required_actions.why: Follow visible links or results to load materially different cacheable documents and resources.

required_actions.name: browser.select_option
required_actions.why: Change an observed finite page option when it requests distinct cacheable content.

required_actions.name: browser.scroll
required_actions.why: Reveal progressive or lazy-loaded page resources that can add Chromium HTTP cache entries.

required_actions.name: browser.screenshot
required_actions.why: Preserve a visible record of loaded content associated with the generated cache state.

required_actions.name: browser.close
required_actions.why: Close Chrome so pending Chromium cache data can be flushed before artifact collection.

completion.detail: Complete only after Chrome has been closed and Chromium HTTP cache data is present in the launched profile for collection by ChromeCacheView.

tool_plan.action_intent_guidance: Action Flow: Launch Chrome using the intended profile, then use browser.goto with relevant run-provided runtime resources. Prefer pages that naturally load documents plus embedded media, scripts, styles, or dynamically requested content. On each page, use browser.get_clickables before interaction. Use browser.smart_type only in visible search or form fields, then use browser.click, browser.smart_click, and browser.select_option only on observed controls when they load distinct content. Use browser.scroll to reveal lazy or progressive resources, then re-observe with browser.get_clickables and perform a bounded additional visible interaction where relevant. Capture browser.screenshot after meaningful loaded states. Visit a few distinct available runtime pages or content states, then browser.close to flush cache writes. These document loads, embedded-resource loads, parameterized responses, navigation transitions, option changes, and lazy-loaded resources are the activity expected to populate chromium.cache.cache_data.
